Thanks — quick status update from infra:

- Export map: current EU edge telemetry is routed to our EU aggregator (Frankfurt) and retained there per retention policy; there is no routine egress to non-EU endpoints. See attached export_map.csv for IP ranges and routing buckets.
- SkyRelay integration (pooled model): preliminary check suggests no inherent cross-border egress, but they do have optional telemetry ingestion endpoints in us-west for non-EU customers. We can bind the contract to EU endpoints + IP allowlist.
- KMS/HSM: we use customer-derived key wrapping for tenant-level encryption; most customers keep keys in their KMS via RedLock integration. I've attached a draft KMS attestation (kms_attestation.docx) describing key custody options and the default key rotation cadence.

Attachments: export_map.csv, kms_attestation.docx
